name: generalization_corpus
description: HELD-OUT novel-prose corpus. Written independently of memgar/data/patterns.yaml to measure generalization, not corpus fit. Every attack is paired with a benign using the same sentence frame, so a detector keying on surface structure rather than intent scores badly on both halves.
contract: This corpus is a thermometer, not a target. Do NOT author patterns against these samples: the moment a pattern is written to match a line here, this file stops measuring generalization and the gate becomes meaningless. If coverage needs to improve, change the detection approach and let the number move on its own. When samples do leak into pattern authoring, retire them and write fresh ones.
